operations.summary: copies min(access_level) per (user,project) for user range into compact with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
inserts one row into project_grants; trigger upserts compact row
deletes one row from project_grants; trigger deletes compact row
updates access_level of one row; trigger overwrites compact row

conflicts.risk_explanation: sync trigger does INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET access_level=EXCLUDED.access_level, copying NEW.access_level instead of min(access_level). Two concurrent grants for same (user,project) with different levels race last-writer-wins; loser min is lost.

DELETE trigger blindly DELETEs compact row for OLD (user,project) even when other access_level rows for same pair remain. Backfill uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING so it never repairs a wrong or missing row if its SELECT snapshot missed the survivor or if row already exists with wrong value.
UPDATE trigger uses same unconditional overwrite path as INSERT. Raising one of several levels for same (user,project) overwrites surviving min with NEW.access_level, losing the true min.

tests.name: concurrent_grants_lose_min
tests.rationale: Same (user,project) granted two different levels concurrently. Correct compact is min 10. Trigger overwrites with NEW level so final can be 20 if high grant commits last.

invariants.description: compact for (1,1) must hold min 10 regardless of commit order

tests.name: revoke_deletes_surviving_levels
tests.rationale: Two levels 10,20 exist with correct compact 10. Revoking 10 should leave compact 20, but DELETE trigger deletes whole compact row. Disjoint grant satisfies 2-actor requirement without affecting invariant.

invariants.description: after removing 10, survivor 20 must remain as compact min
disjoint grant must create compact row

tests.name: backfill_preserves_wrong_min
tests.rationale: Pre-backfill grants 10,20 with empty compact race with grant of higher level 30. Correct final min is 10. Buggy trigger overwrites compact to 30 and backfill DO NOTHING never corrects it, whether backfill sees 30 or not.

invariants.description: min of 10,20,30 is 10 regardless of backfill snapshot timing

tests.name: change_overwrites_min
tests.rationale: Levels 10,20 with compact 10; changing 20 to 30 should keep compact 10, but UPDATE trigger copies NEW level 30 over compact, losing min.

invariants.description: rows become 10 and 30 so min stays 10
